verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own integrations feeding customer feedback and requests. Shared Slack channels can be linked to a customer from a menu, customer attributes sync with Intercom, the Front integration supports labels, and GitHub sync exists. The evidence shows only fragments of setup and never describes a quick connection flow for the integrations as a group. Missing for 10: documented few-click setup flow for each integration, a broader catalog of supported feedback tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ease of connection.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: To automatically associate Asks from a shared Slack channel with a customer, open the customer page and choose **Link to Slack channel** from the **…** menu.
Customer attributes such as size and revenue can be synced with and managed from Intercom.
The Front integration now allows multiple labels from multi-select label groups
